# Vendored BBF

Source provenance: https://github.com/Tricked-dev/libbbf-rs
Revision: `9a379f3f1dda8417a0cd727b32764f25a53d5626` (2026-09-10), the latest upstream revision when imported.
License: MIT, as declared by the upstream Cargo packages.

This is a complete Git archive of that revision. The server uses the local path dependency,
and the development environment builds `bbfmux` from this copy. No upstream repository
access is required to build, test, run or inspect chapter containers. There are no source
patches at import time. Keep the revision record when making local changes.
